Job Title: International Student Support and Services Student Worker (WS-ST2)

Classification: Student Employee (non-exempt) 

Name and Address of Employer: St. Olaf College, 1520 St. Olaf Ave, Northfield, MN 55057 Department Name: Taylor Center for Equity and Inclusion 

Unit Number (5 digits): 11681 

Length of Position: See Employment Authorization 

Contact Person/Supervisor: Assistant Director for International Student Compliance Wage Range: $12.00-13.00/hour

Description of the Position (Purpose of the Position): 

To assist Taylor Center staff with the management of international student documentation, special projects, and sessions related to international student support and services. 

Transferable Skills: 

● Communicate effectively in an office setting 

● Great attention to detail 

● Responsibility 

● Provide support and assist with problem solving 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

● Scan, link, proof and purge confidential documents 

● Check individual immigration student files for accuracy and completeness 

● Help facilitate and assist at international student information sessions (OPT, Taxes, etc.) 

● Help facilitate and assist at Taylor Center events (Senior Celebration, etc.) 

● Special projects as assigned 

Qualifications: (Education/Experience/Skills) 

● Ability to prioritize, be detail oriented, and accurate 

● Ability to maintain confidentiality 

● Familiarity with F-1 and J-1 immigration documents 

● Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) and Google applications 

● Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



This job description is for general information purposes.  It is not intended to list all duties and responsibilities of the position.  This job description is subject to change at any time by St. Olaf College, with or without prior notice.
